tv.d: an electronic device that receives television signals and displays them on a screen

tv-antenna.d: an omnidirectional antenna tuned to the broadcast frequencies assigned to television

tv camera.d: television equipment consisting of a lens system that focuses an image on a photosensitive mosaic that is scanned by an electron beam

tv set.d: an electronic device that receives television signals and displays them on a screen

tv room.d: a room set aside for viewing television

tv monitor.d: monitor used in a studio for monitoring the program being broadcast
